checks.actualSdk: Not rerun in auth subtask; no SDK, contracts or chain-worker changes. Parent owns final signed SDK/browser acceptance.

implementation: Password reset atomically updates password/email verification, revokes all sessions, tombstones every login wallet, invalidates pending link nonces, audits and consumes the reset token in one D1 batch.
Wallet ownership remains reserved: purpose/address/user_id/verified_at are retained; verification_method=NULL revokes login without financial wallet mutation or schema changes.
Login refuses tombstoned bindings without creating a forked user. Account and public wallet/customer ownership reads exclude tombstones.
Link INSERT/UPSERT checks active user, verified email if present, and live unrevoked session in the mutation. Only same-user tombstones may reactivate; fresh signed nonce is required.
SIWE session insertion conditionally checks active binding and captured salted password hash so a login paused across recovery cannot acquire a new session, including after legitimate relinking.
Wallet linking and conditional mandatory audit remain transactional.
Minimal English reset confirmation instructs new-password login and fresh-signature relinking; states funds/payout addresses unchanged.
